description: I recently completed the [SDCN Academy: Unlock Sweden](https://www.staforum.se/sdcn/sdcn-academy/) in Stockholm, a five-week programme for internationally mobile professionals who moved to Sweden alongside a partner working at one of the city's universities or companies. Our cohort brought together people from 16 countries across 5 continents, with backgrounds spanning research, engineering, tech, healthcare, data, design, HR and project management.

Over these five weeks, we explored what our next chapter in Stockholm could look like: recognising the value of our professional experience, understanding a new labour market and discovering future possibilities. Along the way, introductions quickly turned into conversations, shared advice and plans to meet beyond the programme. Read the full posts [here](https://lnkd.in/p/drd-jQSc) and [here](https://lnkd.in/p/d52fdp9Z).
Thank you to the SDCN team, I look forward to pursuing my adventure in Sweden! 🇸🇪

photos.alt: Day 1 of the programme - SDCN Academy:Unlock Sweden!
